description: One of the best beaches in South Goa for dolphin watching and fishing trips. Mobor beach is 49.1 km away from Panaji. This beach area has many spas and healing centers. At Mobor beach you can enjoy water sports like jet skiing, windsurfing, parasailing and banana ride. One of the favourite activities here is biking in the sand. Most tourists come to this beach just for biking. There are some peaceful spots here where you won’t find many people and you can be at your own peace and enjoy nature. There are also secluded covers where you can relax. There are a lot of beach side shops where one can get gifts and handicrafts. There are also many stalls which sell fresh juices. The most common stalls here are the tender coconut stalls. Not to forget the beach shacks and restaurants which serve delicious food and drinks. If you want to spend the night, there are beach resorts and hotels with their private pools. Night rides are the best! Rent your vehicles on the Goa app at a reasonable price. Do not forget to watch the beautiful sunrise and visit healing centers. These are the most popular things to do here. Make the best use of your stay in Goa…. How To Reach Mobor Beach By Air About 38 kilometers separate Mobor Beach from Goa International Airport. The trip there will take an hour. You have a variety of pre-paid taxi alternatives from the Goa Airport to Mobor Beach that will get you there comfortably. Also, you can hire a car or a bike and embark on a thrilling journey. How To Reach Mobor Beach By Road There are several ways to get from one area to another by car to get to Mobor Beach. The city's numerous neighborhoods are connected to Goa's coastline by a number of state-run bus lines. In addition, the highways and roads leading to Mobor Beach Goa are well-built and maintained. Due to this, getting there by automobile or taxi from big cities like Delhi, Mumbai, and Pune is simple. How To Reach Mobor Beach By Rail The closest train station to Mobor beach is Madgaon. Canacona, Sanverdam Church, and Vasco Da Gama are a few further well-known train stations. The distance from Madgaon Railway Station to Mobor Beach is roughly 12.62 kilometers. You can take a local bus, an auto-rickshaw, or a taxi to Mobor beach from the railway station. How To Reach Beach From Panaji You can use any local method of transportation to travel from Panaji to Mobor Beach. It is 48.6 kilometers away and can be reached in about an hour thanks to good road connections. It is simple to catch the train to Madgaon or Vasco Da Gama Train Stations, where you may then book a cab or ride a bike to your destination. Best Time to Visit Mobor Beach The best season to go to Mobor Beach South Goa is in the winter if you have a trip booked there. November through February should be covered. Right now, the weather is fantastic. Tourists may anticipate a tranquil trip to the shore. On the other side, summers can get very hot. But because of the severe heat, the months of March through May can be especially uncomfortable. So, avoid going to Mobor from March to September. Also, if you intend to travel there in the summer, you should enjoy the water activities at Mabor Beach.
